input: Prepare me for a meeting with Attio (attio.com)

challenges.evidence: A customer review reported two weeks of difficulty connecting exhibition leads, inability to enroll more than 10 people at a time in sequences, slow support, and system bugs.
challenges.challenge: Workflow and outreach scalability can create customer friction.

challenges.evidence: A customer review said workflow credit consumption becomes expensive for complex automations and cited a 100-record limit for a “find records” workflow block, making some bulk use cases difficult.
challenges.challenge: Automation economics and bulk-processing limits may constrain complex or large-scale workflows.

challenges.evidence: Its engineering thesis describes schema as context and generative application logic as core problems in building the AI future of CRM, rather than simply layering prompts onto a conventional CRM.
challenges.challenge: Attio is tackling the technical complexity of making CRM data useful to both humans and agents.

key_people.name: Nicolas Sharp
key_people.title: CEO & Co-founder
key_people.recent: Authored the October launch of Attio’s architecture for Agentic Revenue and framed the company’s next phase around a hybrid architecture for people and agents.

key_people.name: Alexander Christie
key_people.title: CTO & Co-founder
key_people.recent: Outlined Attio’s Universal Context approach, describing schema-as-context and generative application logic as foundations for AI-native CRM.

key_people.name: Shriya Anand
key_people.title: Chief of Staff
key_people.recent: Announced Attio’s fourth Graduate Associate cohort and described early-career hiring as a core part of the company’s talent philosophy.

key_people.name: Kate Donnellan
key_people.title: Campaigns Lead
key_people.recent: Described Attio’s brand campaign positioning: AI changes the work leading to a win, while the human celebration of winning remains constant.

priorities.evidence: Attio launched a hybrid architecture for people and agents, positioning it as the foundation for scaling revenue operations.
priorities.priority: Build the architecture for agentic revenue: a CRM designed for people and AI agents to work together.

priorities.evidence: The launch introduced a SQL engine, a live Postgres-compatible Data Connectors endpoint, and support for agents working across hundreds of millions of records.
priorities.priority: Expand agent-scale data access and analytics through SQL and live data connectivity.

priorities.evidence: Activities launched in beta to capture support conversations, social DMs, product events, and other interactions as structured first-class data.
priorities.priority: Broaden the CRM data model beyond email and meetings so agents can act on more customer signals.

priorities.evidence: Attio says it is scaling engineering, expanding globally, and accelerating AI primitives; its graduate program is being opened for a fourth cohort, with graduates moving into full-time roles across the company.
priorities.priority: Scale engineering, global operations, and the talent pipeline around AI-native CRM.

what_they_do.value: Attio is the agentic CRM that meets you where you work, compounds every customer signal into context, then acts on it across your pipeline to let you move at unmatched speed and scale.

missing_fields: key_people.Drew Peterson recent statement or action

recent_changes.summary: Attio launched SQL Engine, Data Connectors, Agent Scale, and Activities in beta, with SQL-powered questions available in Ask Attio on all plans and enterprise availability for API/MCP/Workflow SQL and Data Connectors.
recent_changes.headline: Introducing the architecture for Agentic Revenue

recent_changes.summary: Attio shipped a cluster of product updates focused on capturing deal activity, putting more process on autopilot, and improving record navigation.
recent_changes.headline: Activities, workflow updates, and redesigned record pages

recent_changes.summary: Attio added workflow defer reasons and expanded domain validation in its App SDK.
recent_changes.headline: App SDK v1.1.9

recent_changes.summary: Attio opened applications for its fourth six-month Graduate Associate cohort, continuing a stated strategy of hiring and developing early-career builders.
recent_changes.headline: Fourth Graduate Associate cohort opened

talking_points: How are you deciding which revenue motions should be agent-owned versus human-reviewed as SQL, Data Connectors, Agent Scale, and Activities move from launch into adoption?
What needs to improve most for customers running high-volume workflows—sequence limits, bulk processing, credit economics, or support reliability?
As Attio expands engineering, global operations, and its graduate pipeline, where is the biggest execution bottleneck in turning the agentic-CRM vision into repeatable enterprise adoption?
